cli.rationale: Product-owned CLI exposes machine-readable change, spec, readiness and instruction operations.

self-hosting.rationale: The CLI and durable Markdown planning files run on user-controlled machines.

telemetry-opt-out.rationale: OpenSpec documents telemetry identifiers and opt-out controls.

free-tier.rationale: OpenSpec is freely installable MIT software; coding assistant costs are separate.

license.rationale: The OpenSpec application repository is MIT licensed.

starting-price.rationale: OpenSpec is freely installable MIT software; coding assistant costs are separate.

byo-subscription.rationale: OpenSpec runs inside the user's existing assistant via installed skills and commands, so that assistant's native sign-in applies. Not tested. Scope: OpenSpec framework.

claude-code.rationale: Named official integration; OpenSpec installs its workflow into Claude Code, which runs it. Rechecked in docs/supported-tools.md at 579fcac. Scope: OpenSpec framework.

review.note: OpenSpec installs skill and command files into the assistant's own directories and the user invokes the workflow inside that assistant; OpenSpec itself does not launch or run the harness, so it is not a harness the ADE can run under the agents definition.
